title: OpenAI sets a November cutoff for its models in Cursor
friendlyTitle: OpenAI plans to remove its models from Cursor in November
summary: OpenAI says it intends to stop providing models to Cursor on November 12 following Cursor’s acquisition by SpaceX. OpenAI cites concerns about contract and terms-of-service compliance and says future models will not be supplied through the integration.
friendlySummary: OpenAI says Cursor will lose access to its models on November 12 after SpaceX bought the coding tool. Future OpenAI models will not be added there.
whyItMatters: Developers who depend on OpenAI models inside Cursor now have a transition deadline. Teams should identify model-specific workflows, test alternatives and avoid assuming that access through a third-party coding tool is permanent.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Cursor users should test other models now and check whether important coding workflows depend on OpenAI.
